entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely terrible cycling shoes I bought. This is a joke. I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
The issue is that they've given me massive blisters! I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats a dozen times. They are poorly designed and I want a full refund. Don't waste my time.
I can certainly understand your frustration with that, and I apologize for the discomfort they've caused. To proceed, I just need to pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy?

I don't have it! Just use my phone number. And you better not tell me I can't return them. I've had them for a couple of months, but your website says 10 days. If you can't handle this, get me a manager right now, because I am not playing games.
There's no need for a manager, I can absolutely help you with this. Using your phone number... Okay, I see your order right here for the Mountain Bike shoes, placed 68 days ago.
So? Are you going to give me my money back or not? I'm one click away from posting reviews everywhere about how your products cause injuries.
You are absolutely correct about our policy. The shoes are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I am processing the return for you right now. There's no problem at all.
Oh. So... you're just approving it? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. I've just emailed you a prepaid shipping label. Simply package the shoes, attach the label, and drop them at the post office. Once our warehouse receives them, we will process your full refund to the original payment method. You'll get an email notification as soon as that's done.
Huh. Okay. Well... good. That's what I expected.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
